name: Greece
tagline: Public universities teach in Greek; the English routes are few and paid
summary: Greek public universities are free and highly regarded, but they teach in Greek, and entry for Greek-speaking students runs through the national Panhellenic examinations. Since a 2022 law change, a small number of public universities have been allowed to run separate English-taught undergraduate programmes with tuition fees, and these are the realistic route for a Danish IB student. There are only a handful of them, they are genuinely good, and they cost between EUR 6,000 and EUR 17,000 a year. Beyond that there is the private, American-accredited college sector.
whyConsider: The University of Athens runs a 6-year MD taught entirely in English with clinical training across sixteen Athens hospitals
Its BA in Archaeology, History and Literature of Ancient Greece is taught in English for EUR 6,000 a year - studying ancient Greece in Athens
Living costs are low by Northern European standards and you are an EU citizen, so no visa
English-taught programmes accept the IB directly rather than requiring the Panhellenic examinations
The American College of Greece teaches in English with US accreditation if you want a liberal-arts style degree
watchOuts: The overwhelming majority of Greek bachelor teaching is in Greek - do not assume a department has an English track
English-taught programmes at public universities charge tuition, unlike the Greek-taught ones
The English-taught MD at Athens costs EUR 17,000 a year for six years and requires UCAT or MCAT on top of your IB
Deadlines are set programme by programme; there is no single national deadline for these English-taught routes

Several basic facts - the foreign-nationals quota, work rights, student housing and whether Greek-taught public study is free for EU citizens - could not be verified from official sources and need checking

ibRecognition.minimumPoints: Set per programme. The University of Athens MD in English requires at least 36 points overall. Its BA in Archaeology, History and Literature of Ancient Greece asks for an 'indicative average grade' of 70% or equivalent.
ibRecognition.subjectLevelRule: The University of Athens MD in English requires 36 points overall 'including three higher-level subjects (two of them should be selected from Physics, Chemistry, and Biology)'.
notes: The English-taught programmes accept the IB Diploma directly as a school-leaving qualification - you do not sit the Panhellenic examinations for them.

Admission to Greek-taught public programmes is controlled by the Ministry of Education, which, in the words of Aristotle University, 'accepts and processes all entry applications'. There is a separate quota route for foreign nationals, but its rules, deadlines and whether EU citizens are covered could not be verified from an official page on 2026-09-22.
Whether DOATAP or another recognition step is required for an IB Diploma was not confirmed on the pages read.

deadlines.notes: The admission requirements page refers to 'the deadline of applications' and allows predicted scores if results arrive later, but does not state the date. Contact medicen@uoa.gr.

steps: Decide which route you are taking. For a Danish IB student there are effectively two: an English-taught programme at a public university, or a private English-language college such as ACG/Deree.

Find the programme. The Ministry of Education runs a programme finder at studies.minedu.gov.gr covering bachelor's and master's programmes in Greek and English, and Study in Greece runs the @SiG platform.
Apply directly to the programme. Each English-taught programme runs its own application; there is no single national deadline for this route.

Prepare English proof and, for medicine, an admissions test. The Athens MD accepts UCAT or MCAT and requires IELTS 7.5 overall with at least 6.5 in each component, TOEFL 80, or Cambridge FCE at B2. The Ancient Greece BA requires TOEFL 88 or IELTS 6.5 with at least 5.5 in each component.
Pay the deposit on acceptance. The Athens MD takes a non-refundable EUR 5,000 deposit followed by two instalments of EUR 12,000 in total, in September and January.
As an EU citizen, move to Greece and register locally; there is no visa to apply for.
application.selectionNotes: The English-taught programmes select on your IB result, English proof and, for medicine, an admissions test. Greek-taught public places are allocated through the Panhellenic examinations, with a separate quota for foreign nationals administered by the Ministry - the mechanics of that quota could not be verified from an official page and must be checked with the Ministry before relying on it.

language.englishTaughtBachelors: Few. The Ministry's portal advertises 'over 200 study programs taught in English', but that count is dominated by master's programmes. At undergraduate level, the confirmed English-taught programmes at the University of Athens are the BA in Archaeology, History and Literature of Ancient Greece, the MD programme in English, and the MPharm integrated master in Pharmacy. Aristotle University lists 41 undergraduate programmes but none were confirmed as English-taught. The International Hellenic University's undergraduate programmes are listed only in Greek; its 26 English-language programmes are all master's.
language.englishProof: Set per programme. University of Athens MD: TOEFL 80, IELTS 7.5 overall with at least 6.5 in each component, or Cambridge FCE at B2. BA in Ancient Greece: TOEFL 88 (with minimum 17 Listening, 17 Writing, 18 Reading, 20 Speaking), IELTS 6.5 overall with at least 5.5 in each component, or Cambridge FCE at B2. Native speakers are exempt. Whether IB English A or B is accepted in place of a test was not confirmed on the pages read.
notes: Greek is required for the vast majority of bachelor programmes at public universities. This is the single most important thing to understand about Greece.
The English-taught programmes are genuinely taught in English, including clinical teaching on the Athens MD.
You will need some Greek for everyday life outside the university, especially outside Athens.

tuitionEuEea.value: The English-taught programmes charge the same fee to EU and non-EU students. University of Athens MD in English: EUR 17,000 a year, with the page stating 'Tuition fees for the academic year 2026-2027 for EU and non-EU citizens are EUR 17.000'. University of Athens BA in Archaeology, History and Literature of Ancient Greece: EUR 6,000 a year, paid in two instalments in June and January. Whether Greek-taught public bachelor study is free for EU citizens could not be verified from an official page read on 2026-09-22.
tuitionEuEea.year: 2026-2027 (MD); BAAG page undated but current on 2026-09-22

tuitionNonEu.value: Same as EU for the University of Athens English-taught programmes: EUR 17,000 a year for the MD, EUR 6,000 a year for the BA in Ancient Greece.

notes: The Athens MD requires a non-refundable EUR 5,000 deposit, then EUR 12,000 split across September and January.
Monthly living costs in Athens or Thessaloniki were not published on any official page read on 2026-09-22 and need checking before use.
Private college fees, including ACG/Deree, were not published on the pages read.

funding: No scholarship scheme aimed at EU bachelor applicants was verified from an official page. ACG/Deree advertises a merit scholarship for EU students but the amounts were not published on the pages read.
Danish SU for a full degree abroad requires programme approval by Uddannelses- og Forskningsstyrelsen - check with your studievejleder.
Check each English-taught programme's own page; these are new programmes and scholarship arrangements change.
residency: As a Danish EU citizen you have the right to live and study in Greece and will normally register locally for stays over three months. Non-EU students need a student visa and residence permit. The specific Greek procedures, documents and timescales could not be verified from an official page on 2026-09-22 - the Study in Greece visa page directs non-EU students to a third-party visa service rather than setting out the rules.
healthcare: As an EU citizen bring your EU health insurance card for necessary care in the Greek public system. Detailed requirements for students, and what non-EU students must arrange, were not published on the pages read on 2026-09-22.

institutions.name: National and Kapodistrian University of Athens
institutions.englishBachelors: Three confirmed: BA in Archaeology, History and Literature of Ancient Greece; MD programme in English; MPharm integrated master in Pharmacy
institutions.note: The oldest university in Greece and the only one with a real English-taught undergraduate offering - the MD at EUR 17,000 a year and the Ancient Greece BA at EUR 6,000.

institutions.name: Aristotle University of Thessaloniki
institutions.englishBachelors: None confirmed. AUTh lists 41 undergraduate programmes but no English-taught bachelor was identified on the pages read.
institutions.note: The largest university in Greece and in the Balkans, but admission runs through the Ministry of Education and teaching is in Greek.

institutions.name: University of Crete
institutions.englishBachelors: None confirmed on the pages read
institutions.note: Research-strong, especially in physics and the life sciences through its links with FORTH, but bachelor teaching is in Greek.

institutions.name: National Technical University of Athens
institutions.englishBachelors: None confirmed on the pages read
institutions.note: Greece's leading engineering school, with five-year integrated diploma degrees - but taught in Greek.

institutions.name: Athens University of Economics and Business
institutions.englishBachelors: None confirmed on the pages read
institutions.note: The main economics and business university in Greece, with a strong research reputation in economics.

institutions.name: International Hellenic University
institutions.englishBachelors: None. Its undergraduate programmes are listed only in Greek; its 26 English-language programmes are master's.
institutions.note: The name promises more than the undergraduate reality - the English teaching here is at master's level, through its University Center for International Study Programs.

institutions.name: University of the Aegean
institutions.englishBachelors: None confirmed on the pages read
institutions.note: Spread across six Aegean islands, which is unusual and appealing, but teaching is in Greek.

institutions.name: University of Patras
institutions.englishBachelors: None confirmed on the pages read
institutions.note: A large research university in the Peloponnese, strongest in engineering and computer engineering.

institutions.name: University of Ioannina
institutions.englishBachelors: None confirmed on the pages read
institutions.note: In the mountains of Epirus, with a well-regarded medical school and a very low cost of living.

institutions.name: The American College of Greece (Deree)
institutions.englishBachelors: All undergraduate programmes are taught in English, awarding BA and BSc degrees across three schools
institutions.note: Private, American-accredited (NEASC) and entirely English-taught, with separate admission tracks for Greek, EU, North American and other applicants; tuition was not published on the pages read.

institutions.name: Athens School of Fine Arts
institutions.englishBachelors: None confirmed; teaching is in Greek
institutions.note: Greece's national art school, with entry by portfolio and entrance examination, taught in Greek.

institutions.name: University of Piraeus
institutions.englishBachelors: None confirmed on the pages read
institutions.note: Known above all for maritime studies and shipping, which fits the port city it sits in.
